name: hello
description: Return a constant string and assert the result.
source:
M hello

F main->str
  R "Hello, world!"

X hello_output
  A (= (main) "Hello, world!")

name: add_two
description: Accept an i64 input, add two, and test the function.
source:
M add_two

F main input:i64->i64
  R (+ input 2)

X adds_two
  A (= (main 3) 5)

name: compact_authoring
description: Postfix field/index reads, P builder writeback, inferred locals and explicitly typed empty/variant contexts, including alias snapshot tests.
source:
M compact_authoring

T Row struct
  values:[i64]

T Input struct
  rows:[Row]

F double_firsts input:Input->[i64]
  L out (buf i64 (# input.rows))
  E row input.rows
    P out (* row.values[0] 2)
  R (finish out)

F main input:Input->[i64]
  R (double_firsts input)

X empty_rows
  A (= (main (Input rows=[])) [])

X first_values
  A (= (main (Input rows=[(Row values=[1 2]) (Row values=[3 4])])) [2 6])

X immutable_aliases
  L out (buf i64 2)
  L original out
  P out 7
  L snapshot (finish out)
  P out (count out)
  A (= (finish original) [])
  A (= snapshot [7])
  A (= (finish out) [7 1])

X necessary_annotations
  L empty:[str] []
  A (= (# empty) 0)
  L missing:option i64 (none)
  C missing
    some value
      A false
    none
      A true

name: pure_data
description: Strict numeric parsing, typed maps, Unicode strings and immutable record/array snapshots.
source:
M pure_data
T Row struct
  score:i64
F main input:str->result map i64 str
  C (parse_i64 (str_trim input))
    ok value
      R (ok (map_put (map i64) "value" value))
    err problem
      R (err problem)
X parsed
  A (= (main " 42 ") (ok (map_put (map i64) "value" 42)))
X snapshots
  L original (Row score=1)
  L revised (with original score=2)
  A (= original.score 1)
  A (= revised.score 2)
  A (= (array_set [1 2] 0 9) [9 2])
  A (= (str_slice "aé😀" 1 2) "é😀")

name: config_validator
description: Decode a strict service configuration, accumulate domain validation errors, and reject production debugging; maintained through native MCP with source tests.
source:
M config_validator

T Server struct
  host:str
  port:i64

T Config struct
  name:str
  environment:str
  server:Server
  timeout_ms:i64
  retries:i64
  debug:bool

T Validation struct
  valid:bool
  errors:[str]

F blank value:str->bool
  R (= (str_trim value) "")

F has_nul value:str->bool
  C (str_find value "\0")
    some position
      R true
    none
      R false

F in_range value:i64 lower:i64 upper:i64->bool
  R (& (>= value lower) (<= value upper))

F known_environment value:str->bool
  R (| (= value "development") (| (= value "staging") (= value "production")))

F debug_allowed environment:str debug:bool->bool
  R (! (& (= environment "production") debug))

F validate config:Config->Validation
  L errors (buf str 8)
  ? (| (blank (. config name)) (has_nul (. config name)))
    S errors (push errors "name_invalid")
  ? (! (known_environment (. config environment)))
    S errors (push errors "environment_invalid")
  ? (| (blank (. (. config server) host)) (has_nul (. (. config server) host)))
    S errors (push errors "host_invalid")
  ? (! (in_range (. (. config server) port) 1 65535))
    S errors (push errors "port_out_of_range")
  ? (! (in_range (. config timeout_ms) 100 300000))
    S errors (push errors "timeout_out_of_range")
  ? (! (in_range (. config retries) 0 10))
    S errors (push errors "retries_out_of_range")
  ? (! (debug_allowed (. config environment) (. config debug)))
    S errors (push errors "production_debug_enabled")
  R (Validation valid=(= (count errors) 0) errors=(finish errors))

F main document:str->Validation
  C (json_decode Config document)
    ok config
      R (validate config)
    err problem
      R (Validation valid=false errors=[(cat "decode: " problem)])

X valid_development
  A (. (main "{\"name\":\"apx-service\",\"environment\":\"development\",\"server\":{\"host\":\"127.0.0.1\",\"port\":8080},\"timeout_ms\":1000,\"retries\":3,\"debug\":true}") valid)

X valid_production
  A (. (main "{\"name\":\"apx-service\",\"environment\":\"production\",\"server\":{\"host\":\"127.0.0.1\",\"port\":8080},\"timeout_ms\":1000,\"retries\":3,\"debug\":false}") valid)

X port_lower_boundary
  A (. (main "{\"name\":\"apx-service\",\"environment\":\"development\",\"server\":{\"host\":\"127.0.0.1\",\"port\":1},\"timeout_ms\":1000,\"retries\":3,\"debug\":true}") valid)

X port_upper_boundary
  A (. (main "{\"name\":\"apx-service\",\"environment\":\"development\",\"server\":{\"host\":\"127.0.0.1\",\"port\":65535},\"timeout_ms\":1000,\"retries\":3,\"debug\":true}") valid)

X port_zero
  A (= (. (main "{\"name\":\"apx-service\",\"environment\":\"development\",\"server\":{\"host\":\"127.0.0.1\",\"port\":0},\"timeout_ms\":1000,\"retries\":3,\"debug\":true}") errors) ["port_out_of_range"])

X strict_boolean_port
  A (= (. (main "{\"name\":\"apx-service\",\"environment\":\"development\",\"server\":{\"host\":\"127.0.0.1\",\"port\":true},\"timeout_ms\":1000,\"retries\":3,\"debug\":true}") errors) ["decode: numeric_out_of_range"])

X host_nul
  A (= (. (main "{\"name\":\"apx-service\",\"environment\":\"development\",\"server\":{\"host\":\"bad\\u0000host\",\"port\":8080},\"timeout_ms\":1000,\"retries\":3,\"debug\":true}") errors) ["host_invalid"])

X unknown_field
  A (= (. (main "{\"name\":\"apx-service\",\"environment\":\"development\",\"server\":{\"host\":\"127.0.0.1\",\"port\":8080},\"timeout_ms\":1000,\"retries\":3,\"debug\":true,\"unexpected\":1}") errors) ["decode: extra_field"])

X missing_fields
  A (= (. (main "{}") errors) ["decode: missing_field"])

X malformed_document
  A (= (. (main "{") errors) ["decode: invalid_json"])

X duplicate_fields
  A (= (. (main "{\"name\":\"one\",\"name\":\"two\"}") errors) ["decode: duplicate_field"])

X production_debug_is_rejected
  A (= (. (main "{\"name\":\"apx-service\",\"environment\":\"production\",\"server\":{\"host\":\"127.0.0.1\",\"port\":8080},\"timeout_ms\":1000,\"retries\":3,\"debug\":true}") errors) ["production_debug_enabled"])

X domain_errors_accumulate
  A (= (. (main "{\"name\":\"\",\"environment\":\"unknown\",\"server\":{\"host\":\"\",\"port\":0},\"timeout_ms\":99,\"retries\":11,\"debug\":true}") errors) ["name_invalid" "environment_invalid" "host_invalid" "port_out_of_range" "timeout_out_of_range" "retries_out_of_range"])
